Prepare a Cross Object for Whole-Genome Analysis

Source: R/primeCross.R
primeCross.Rd

Converts a qtl cross object into a "wgCross" object suitable for use with qtlAim and gpAim.

Two analysis types are supported, selected via the type argument:

"interval" (default)

Missing marker genotypes are imputed, co-located markers are collapsed via fixMap, and interval midpoint scores are computed for each inter-marker interval. This is the recommended type for QTL detection in biparental populations.

"marker"

Missing marker genotypes are imputed and co-located markers are collapsed, but no interval data are generated. Use this type when working directly with marker scores rather than interval midpoints.

The resulting object retains the full qtl cross structure and can still be used with all qtl package functions.

Usage

primeCross(
  object,
  type = "interval",
  impute = "MartinezCurnow",
  consensus.mark = TRUE,
  id = "id",
  subset = NULL,
  infer = "mid"
)

Arguments

object

A qtl cross object. Supported population types are "bc", "dh", "f2", and "riself".

type

Character string, either "interval" (default) or "marker". Controls whether interval markers are generated according to the rules of the argument infer below in addition to imputed marker scores.

impute

Character string selecting the imputation method for missing marker genotypes. One of "MartinezCurnow" (default) or "Broman". Partial matching is allowed.

consensus.mark

Logical. If TRUE (default), co-located markers are collapsed to consensus genotypes via fixMap before imputation.

id

Character string naming the column in object$pheno that uniquely identifies genotypic rows. Default "id".

subset

Character vector of chromosome names to retain. If NULL (default) all chromosomes are used.

infer

Either "mid" (default) to place inferred interval markers at interval midpoints, or a numeric cM step size passed to lambdaf() for a finer-resolution grid. Only used when type = "interval".

Value

An object of class c("wgCross", cls, "cross") where cls is the original population class ("bc", "dh", etc.). The $geno list elements are augmented with:

$imputed.data

Imputed marker genotype matrix (lines x markers) in additive \(\pm 1\) coding.

$dist

Inter-marker distances in Morgans.

$theta

Recombination fractions between adjacent markers.

$interval.data

Interval midpoint score matrix (lines x intervals). Only present when type = "interval".

$inferred.map

Named numeric vector of inferred interval midpoint positions in cM. Only present when type = "interval".

The $type field records the value of type for use by downstream analysis functions. When consensus.mark = TRUE (default), $colocated.markers is a data frame listing any markers that were collapsed to consensus genotypes by fixMap.
